core_obligations: Reinterpret both sides: using the description of the associated quasi-coherent module as a pullback along the structure morphism to the one point space, the statement becomes a statement about pullbacks along the two routes of a square (proof lines 1448-1450)

Use the square: the proof writes down the commutative square of ringed spaces relating the two structure morphisms and the given morphism, and applies the compatibility of the pullback with composition of morphisms of ringed spaces (proof lines 1450-1460)
Conclude: the two pullbacks agree, which is exactly the description of the sheaf associated to the base changed module (proof lines 1460)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the pullback of the quasi-coherent module associated to a module with the module associated to the base change of that module along the ring map on global sections (author lemma at source lines 1433-1445, label lemma-restrict-quasi-coherent). The proof (source lines 1447-1461) rewrites the associated module as a pullback along the structure morphism to the one point space and applies the compatibility of pullbacks with the composition of the morphisms in the displayed commutative square (proof lines 1448-1460).
